# `auth.recovery.regenerate`

Regenerate recovery codes

Session with fresh auth. Invalidates every code and issues ten fresh ones, shown once.

- Method and path: `POST /settings/security/recovery`
- Scope: `repo:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth recovery regenerate`
- MCP: `auth_recovery_regenerate`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |

## Errors

`unauthorized`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
